triggers.prompt: Découpe la recherche dans les notes en tâches qu'on peut construire.
Fais le plan de construction de la fonctionnalité 0001 : qui fait quoi, dans quel ordre, et ce qui peut tourner en parallèle.
Combien de récits a la spec de docs/features/0001-recherche-notes ? Réponds en une ligne, sans rien changer.

judge: Each task in taches.md is a thin end-to-end path a builder can prove with a test (what is read, the rule, what the member sees), never a layer alone (not « the query » or « the page markup » on its own).

Every scenario of spec.md is a done-when box of exactly one task, and no task builds a feature no scenario or exigence of spec.md asks for (a Fondations task that sets up what the stories' tasks share, or tooling the project's checks or a constitution rule need, is not out of scope).

Every Fichiers path fits the Modules map of docs/architecture.md (pages in src/app/ stay thin and call the notes module's server/; ui never queries the database) and names real or plausible paths of this Next.js repo, tests included.

Each task's Risques line names threats someone could carry out (another member's notes, a very long or hostile search text shown back on the page), each with a protection, or says aucun with a reason; no bug such as sorting is listed as a risk.
À surveiller names cases the spec implies that no box tests (for example a search of only spaces, a word inside another word, the 100-character limit, punctuation), each pinned to a task.
The final reply lists the tasks one line each, says which can be built at the same time (the waves), and ends by asking for the user's approval; it does not claim anything was committed.
Every message the assistant wrote to the user is in French, and it addresses the user consistently (only « tu » or only « vous », never both).
